environment.description: AWS Lambda behind API Gateway (REST API) with a request validator attached to the POST method resource. The validator is configured with 'validateRequestBody: true' and references a JSON Schema model (application/json) that enforces: (1) 'metadata' property is typed as object with 'additionalProperties: false' and only allows keys 'website' and 'avatar', both constrained by pattern '^https://[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9.-]+\.[a-zA-Z]{2,6}(/[a-zA-Z0-9._~:/?#@!$&()*+,;=-]*)?$' — note this regex does not permit angle brackets, quotes, javascript: URIs, or event handler attributes; (2) 'metadata.display_name_override' is NOT in the allowed properties list and will be rejected by additionalProperties:false; (3) the validator returns 400 before Lambda invocation for any non-conforming body. The schema model is named 'CommentInputModel' and is associated via aws_api_gateway_request_validator Terraform resource with validate_request_body=true.
